_comment: GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06) blind top-1 accuracy (%) on each benchmark's multiple-choice questions, rescored from reproduce/data/gpt4o/ by scripts/blind_baselines.py. unparseable_wrong: responses that name no option count as incorrect (the paper's rule; Table 1 prints these rounded). unparseable_random_seed0: such responses get a random option seeded by (seed, benchmark, question id).
